name: Seal Princess ~Ohime-sama wa Fuuinchuu~
original_name: シールプリンセス～お姫様は封印中～
source:
In a fantasy setting world there is a small country sandwiched between great powers. The king is the descendant of an evil king who sealed demon king powers inside his body. The seal has weakened over time, so a ritual is required to strengthen it. The three princesses are the means to perform the ritual and prevent evil king resurrection. They are ready to cooperate and accept any incoming insults.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在一個奇幻的世界中，有一個夾在大國之間的小國。國王是邪王的後裔，將魔王之力封存在體內。隨著時間的推移，封印逐漸減弱，因此需要舉行儀式來強化它。三位公主是舉行儀式、阻止邪王復活的關鍵。她們已下定決心配合，願意承受任何凌辱。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
